content: The co-administration of CYP3A4 inhibitors with fentanyl requires careful monitoring for respiratory depression and sedation at frequent intervals. Adjustments to the fentanyl dosage should be considered until stable drug effects are achieved. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of fentanyl (both transdermal and transmucosal) by affecting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is recommended. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of fesoterodine, flecainide, and fluconazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clinical monitoring is recommended when co-administering with antiarrhythmics. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of fludrocortisone, flunisolide (inhaled), fluoxetine, and flurazepam through CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. For benzodiazepines like flurazepam, consider lowering the dose or using alternatives. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of fluticasone (both furoate and inhaled forms) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of fluvastatin, requiring therapy modification and close monitoring. For HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors not contraindicated with darunavir, start with the lowest recommended dose and titrate while monitoring for safety. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of fosamprenavir, fosaprepitant, and fostamatinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Garlic decreases darunavir levels through an unknown mechanism, necessitating caution and monitoring. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of gefitinib, glimepiride, and glipizide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Reports of hyperglycemia due to insulin resistance with protease inhibitors should be considered. Darunavir decreases the effects of glyburide, insulin (various types), and miglitol, likely due to insulin resistance. Therapy adjustments and monitoring are recommended. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of grapefruit, green tea, and griseofulvin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Green tea may increase the risk of bleeding when combined with darunavir. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of guanfacine, haloperidol, and hydrocodone through CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary, especially for hydrocodone, as co-administration with CYP3A4 inhibitors may result in potentially fatal respiratory depression. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of hydrocortisone, hydroxyprogesterone caproate, and iloperidone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Iloperidone, a time-dependent CYP3A inhibitor, may increase plasma levels of drugs eliminated by CYP3A4. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of imipramine, indinavir, and insulin aspart by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and monitoring are recommended. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of itraconazole, ivacaftor, and ixabepilone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. When co-administering itraconazole with darunavir/ritonavir, itraconazole should not exceed 200 mg/day. Ivacaftor dosage should be reduced when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Darunavir decreases the levels or effects of ketamine and increases the levels or effects of lacosamide and lapatinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of lenacapavir, letermovir, and levamlodipine through CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and monitoring are necessary, especially for amlodipine, as co-administration with CYP3A inhibitors may require dose reduction. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of levomilnacipran, lidocaine, and liraglutide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. For levomilnacipran, do not exceed 80 mg/day when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of lofexidine, lopinavir, and loratadine through CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and monitoring are necessary. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of losartan, lumacaftor/ivacaftor, and lumateperone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. When initiating lumacaftor/ivacaftor in patients taking strong CYP3A inhibitors, reduce the dose to one tablet daily for the first week to allow for the steady-state induction effect of lumacaftor. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of maraviroc, marijuana, and mavorixafor by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. For maraviroc, decrease the dose to 150 mg BID when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of medroxyprogesterone, meperidine, and mestranol through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Darunavir decreases the effects of metformin and increases the levels or effects of methadone, methylprednisolone, and metoprolol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of metronidazole, mexiletine, and miconazole vaginal by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of mifepristone, miglitol, and mipomersen by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. For mifepristone, do not exceed 300 mg/day for Cushing syndrome when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of mirtazapine, mirvetuximab soravtansine, and mitotane through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of mometasone (inhaled and intranasal), nafcillin, and naldemedine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Darunavir also decreases the effects of nateglinide and increases the levels or effects of nefazodone, nelfinavir, and netupitant/palonosetron through CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of nevirapine, nicardipine, and nifedipine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of nilotinib, nintedanib, and nirmatrelvir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of nisoldipine, norgestrel, and oliceridine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. For oliceridine, less frequent dosing may be required, and close monitoring for respiratory depression and sedation is necessary.
